title: Page 197
transc:
Gen Butlers Hd Qrs June 12 / 64
Maj Eckert Di
Whiskey arriving here in considerable numbers zodiac every thing indicates
work for as this side of Bergen unity would it
not be well to have spit & material ready for
short notice zebra we will need I think sooner or
later cable for Bergen Knox has asked again for one
for apple mattox but I have told him there is
none on hand at present please send hoe man here
R OBrien


Ft. Monroe June 12 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di
As James town smyrna is within peach or perfume hours
of Knox silver peasant weaseler perhaps it is best to 
hold all as it is till the break up comes
having all in readiness zebra Think we can save considerable
between while house and wicoff vernon and that there will
be no trouble between Wilson Vernon and Gloster Unity Have
asked Knave if he can now protect us on new
rout pedlar will probably have answer whelp zebra will try
and Keep posted about Tambours zodiac water still very rough
Geo D Sheldon
